factions.name: White
factions.description: Order, peace, structure and community. Wins through go-wide boards, efficient removal and lifegain.

factions.name: Blue
factions.description: Knowledge, control and manipulation. Card draw, counterspells and bounce to out-think the opponent.

factions.name: Black
factions.description: Power at any cost, ruthless and self-serving. Removal, reanimation and life-as-a-resource strategies.

factions.name: Red
factions.description: Freedom, emotion and chaos. Fast aggression, direct damage and high-risk high-reward plays.

factions.name: Green
factions.description: Growth, nature and instinct. Big creatures, mana ramp and raw power over subtlety.

factions.name: Colorless / Artifact
factions.description: Cross-color machinery and mana rocks usable in any deck.
